review: 711.4-1: the no_white_mana and combat_timing variants flipped legality through cost payment and 702.87's sorcery timing, not through 711.4 (which cannot fail: level up is present at every counter count); dropped both, keeping the 0- and 9-counter variants.

711.6-1: the Lord of Shatterskull Pass variant is illegal whether power is read from the uppermost box (3) or a level box (6), so it does not test 711.6; relabelled it other as a control (711.6 has no failing branch) and removed the level-box comparison from its expected.

scenarios.title: A leveler within a level range has that range's power, toughness and abilities
decisions: No actions are taken; the board is observed in A's first main phase.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 2 level counters is 3/3 with first strike.

variants.label: six_counters
variants.delta: It has 6 level counters instead of 2.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 6 level counters (the top of LEVEL 2-6) is 3/3 with first strike.

variants.label: one_counter
variants.delta: It has 1 level counter instead of 2.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 1 level counter is 1/1 with no first strike.

variants.label: seven_counters
variants.delta: It has 7 level counters instead of 2.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 7 level counters is 4/4 with double strike, not 3/3 with first strike.

detector.outcome: A static conditioned on its host's level counters lying in a range grants the host keywords while the counters are in the range.
detector.near_miss: A level-conditioned static whose host's level counters lie outside its range, so it gives the host nothing.

scenarios.title: A leveler with N3 or more level counters has the open-ended range's characteristics
decisions: No actions are taken; the board is observed in A's first main phase.

variants.label: seven_counters
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 7 level counters is 4/4 with double strike.

variants.label: twelve_counters
variants.delta: It has 12 level counters instead of 7.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 12 level counters is 4/4 with double strike.

variants.label: six_counters
variants.delta: It has 6 level counters instead of 7.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare with 6 level counters is 3/3 with first strike and not double strike.

detector.outcome: A static conditioned on at least N level counters grants the host keywords while it has that many counters.
detector.near_miss: A level-conditioned static whose host has fewer level counters than its threshold, so it gives the host nothing.

scenarios.title: A leveler can activate level up regardless of its level counters
decisions: A considers activating Student of Warfare's level up ability ({W}: put a level counter on it), tapping Plains.

variants.label: no_counters
variants.expected: Level up is legal to activate with 0 level counters.

variants.label: nine_counters
variants.delta: Student of Warfare has 9 level counters instead of 0.
variants.expected: Level up is legal to activate with 9 level counters.

detector.outcome: A level up candidate is playable (can_play true), whatever the number of level counters on its permanent.
detector.near_miss: Not distinct within the rule: a level up candidate the verdict refuses, for timing or cost, never for its permanent's level counters.

scenarios.title: A leveler below its first level has the uppermost power and toughness
decisions: A activates Student of Warfare's level up ability, tapping Plains. Both players pass; it resolves.

variants.label: zero_to_one
variants.expected: Student of Warfare has 1 level counter, fewer than 2, so it is 1/1 with no keyword abilities.

variants.label: one_to_two
variants.delta: Student of Warfare starts with 1 level counter instead of 0.
variants.expected: Student of Warfare has 2 level counters and is 3/3 with first strike.

scenarios.title: A leveler card in the graveyard has its uppermost power and toughness

setup.notes: Student of Warfare is in A's graveyard (it died with 7 level counters; counters do not persist outside the battlefield).

decisions: A casts Graceful Restoration, tapping all five lands, choosing the mode that returns up to two creature cards with power 2 or less from the graveyard to the battlefield, targeting Student of Warfare.

variants.label: student
variants.expected: Student of Warfare is a legal target: in the graveyard its power is 1 (uppermost box), so the spell resolves and Student of Warfare returns to the battlefield as a 1/1 with no level counters.

variants.label: lord
variants.delta: The creature card in A's graveyard is Lord of Shatterskull Pass instead of Student of Warfare.
variants.expected: Lord of Shatterskull Pass is not a legal target for that mode: in the graveyard its power is 3 (uppermost box).
